Very nice restaurant with great food
Nov 2024 • Couples
We were still on Phu Quoc for a few days after a Vietnam tour and discovered the May Restaurant by chance in the evening, as it was near the Hotel Dusit Princess. The choice of food is great and in part you will also find all variants of curries here, which corresponds more to Thai cuisine. We were 3x there eating and were always very friendly and attentively served. Everything is very tasty, freshly prepared and the food can also be ordered with special requests and according to the degree of sharpness😉. 
We can only recommend it and hope that other holidaymakers have such a good experience.
